payload.note: [llm audit] This is a 0 K static adsorption energy for O on Cu(111), so cell size, timestep and ensemble questions do not apply. The model (MACE-MPA-0, trained on inorganic PBE data) is in domain for a Cu/O surface. The setup is reasonable: a p(3x3) 4-layer slab at the MACE-relaxed lattice constant, 16 Å total vacuum, bottom two layers fixed, and several starting sites tested. Convergence checks are reported for slab thickness (<0.003 eV) and coverage (0.06 eV). The atomic-O reference is internally consistent: the model's isolated-atom energy reproduces a PBE-like O2 binding energy (6.29 eV) and Cu cohesive energy, and the ±0.4 eV uncertainty explicitly covers the known PBE atom-reference overbinding.
